pages.text: Carbon dioxide traps the heat the ground gives off: a forcing $(thing)ΔF = 5.35 ln(C/280 ppm)$() W/m² - 3.7 W/m² for each doubling. Aerosols reflect sunlight back out. The world warms by about $(thing)0.8 K per W/m²$().

The $(item)Climate Engine$() holds the air's CO₂ and aerosols where you set them. Warm it by 1-2.5 K with water and a forecast and it rains; by 2.5-5 K, storms; hold it near today's and the sky clears. (Minecraft's weather is the whole world's.) Cool it 2.5 K or more and snow becomes an $(item)Ice Core$(); a little less, and frozen soil a $(item)Permafrost Sample$(). Past 6 K it runs away.
